forum.title: Feature Request: Collapse all texts groups by default
forum.best_answer_content: I have received confirmation from the development team that this issue will be addressed in the next TouchGFX release.
forum.content_text:
This is a small feature request to fix an annoying quirk of the TouchGFX Designer.

When opening the texts menu in the designer, all of the texts groups are expanded by default. In projects with many texts/groups, its tedious to collapse all of the groups or scroll to the bottom of the expanded groups. I think it would be better if either TGFX stored the state of the groups expansion OR collapsed them all by default.
forum.author: KStea.1
